label: Offline Practice trace review; no human performance or enjoyment measurement

definitions.readRequests: Look around surveys plus Inspect requests; repeated inspections count duplicate identical Inspect request strings within one capture only.
definitions.confirmedActions: Final game-event caption says completed after your confirmation; aggregate totals cross-checked against the manifest confirmation receipts.
definitions.routeObjectiveChoiceTypes: Four explicitly defined script choice categories, not a count of human mental decisions or a complete taxonomy: initial Gallery branch; revise after obstruction; select optional objective; collect after discovery.
definitions.conversationScope: Manifests retain one final caption per scripted request, often a game-event receipt. They do not retain all intermediate Practice permission wording. No claim of zero redundant real-model questions is supported.
definitions.timingScope: Seconds from the per-viewport capture clock; includes local UI/server/automation work. Human reading/reasoning and first-session comprehension were not measured. These non-video captures use no deliberate presentation pauses. Local time is not decomposed into processing and waiting.

waiting.videoPauseNote: Separate video mode deliberately pauses for reading; its elapsed time is not a performance comparison.

gestureComparison.unit: Activated controls, not OS pointer events; source comparison plus compiled browser cases.

desktopNavigationToViewMapCurrentCaption.scope: Reviewed desktop Gallery captures only; narrow screens may require scrolling.

browserEvidence.cooperation: tests/e2e/goal006-cooperation.spec.ts: direct ink; two-mark erase/undo; failed save; exact quote freshness; Pause; narrow and CSS-zoom checks.
browserEvidence.recorder: tests/e2e/flight-recorder.spec.ts: both layouts and desktop sizes, selected pickup declined then reproposed/confirmed, selected but skipped, both home outcomes, setup reset.

limitations: Different encountered obstruction routes prevent treating total requests or time as a matched speed comparison.
A safe blocked passage and successful backtrack are purposeful exploration, not a conversation dead end.
All four capture scripts reached home. Natural-language dead-end rates and redundant real-model permissions remain unmeasured.
